Protocol definitions from https://github.com/synctv-org/synctv/tree/ca91048b9da595e50642a61618b0eabfbc05e09b/synctv-media-providers/proto (MIT). Copied without changes. Go bindings generated with protoc 3.21.12 and protoc-gen-go 1.36.11. Remote transport uses the x-provider-secret metadata field, not a signed JWT. Only Alist, Bilibili and Emby are supported by this upstream remote transport.
